description: This file defines TypeScript types, constants, and functions for interacting with the Zalo messaging platform, including runtime loading, message handling, user and group info, and QR code login.

classes.name: ZaloCtor
classes.description: Constructor for Zalo object, providing login and loginQR methods.

methods.name: loadZcaJsRuntime
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the zca-js runtime module, ensuring it is only loaded once.

methods.name: createZalo
methods.description: Factory function to create a new Zalo instance with optional configuration.
